question: Which of these sentences best describe the ongoing action(s) in the video 1?
choices: Shake the frying pan slightly and continue to tap the spatula against the edge.
Lift up and shake the frying pan in the left hand to distribute the food evenly.
Shake the frying pan back and forth and tap the wooden spatula against the side of the frying pan.
Shake the frying pan in a horizontal motion using my left hand to further stir the plant-based burger in the frying pan and to redistribute the oil.
Lift up and shake the frying pan full of potatoes to flip them.
correct_answer: Lift up and shake the frying pan in the left hand to distribute the food evenly.
